families.name: Pow-R-Line C switchboard

era.value: Introduced late 1980s (1988) by Westinghouse as successor to WF/WRP; built in Sumter SC and Visalia CA; current Eaton product

voltage_rating.value: 240-480-600 Vac, 250 Vdc (2018 guide); 208-600 V (Vol 12 rating table)

branch_breakers.value: Group-mounted feeders: bolt-on molded case breakers 15-1200 A (Table 21.0-2 lists bolt-on fixed MCCB 15-2500 A), drawout MCCB 70-1200 A, fusible switches 30-1200 A. Uses Series C MCCBs (EHD, FD/HFD/FDC, ED, JD, DK/KD/HKD/KDC, LD/HLD/LDC, MDL/HMDL, NG/ND, LG, etc.)

families.overview: Eaton (originally Westinghouse) Class II service-distribution switchboard, UL 891 / NEMA PB-2, front- or rear-access, with individually mounted mains and group-mounted feeder chassis. Evolved from the Westinghouse WF/WRP St. Louis switchboard when the design moved to Sumter SC and Visalia CA in 1988 with the introduction of Series C breakers. Distribution chassis are laid out in X units (1X = 1-3/8 in) on 38X or 50X vertical panel space in 36 in or 45 in wide structures; device X requirements (EHD 1-3X, FD 2-3X, JD 3X, KD 4X, LD/MDL/ND 6X) parallel the PRL4 panelboard chassis. Vol 12 states breaker provisions 'are available for all ratings of the Pow-R-Line C designs including all parts required to complete the cell', but no PRLC-specific provision kit catalog numbers were found in public documents (factory/Sumter quoted).
